# Intention Holistic Health

> Foundations-first wellness support for Kentucky women preparing for pregnancy or rebuilding after birth. Nurse Practitioner-led functional health services including HTMA (Hair Tissue Mineral Analysis) testing, functional lab review, and personalized protocols.

Founded and led by Alicia Harrison, MSN, APRN, FNP-C — a board-certified Family Nurse Practitioner specializing in hormone health, mineral balance, and perinatal wellness. Services are available to Kentucky residents.

## About

- [About Alicia Harrison](https://www.intentionholistichealth.com/about.html): Biography, credentials (MSN, APRN, FNP-C, BHPCC), professional background, and clinical philosophy.
- [Contact](https://www.intentionholistichealth.com/contact.html): Email, location, and form for general inquiries.
- [Apply](https://www.intentionholistichealth.com/apply.html): Intake form for prospective clients.

## Services

- [All services](https://www.intentionholistichealth.com/services/): Foundations-first wellness support overview — Discovery Session, Mineral Insight (HTMA-led path), and The Intention Method (signature program).
- [Discovery Session](https://www.intentionholistichealth.com/services/discovery-session.html): A focused 60-minute 1:1 session to talk through where you are and find your clear next step. $198. Wellness guidance, not medical consultation. Every engagement starts here.
- [Mineral Insight](https://www.intentionholistichealth.com/services/mineral-insight.html): The HTMA-led path — HTMA testing plus three visits to turn your mineral patterns into a personalized plan. Add-ons available: additional functional labs, extra visits, repeat HTMA. Personalized pricing, finalized in the Discovery Session.
- [The Intention Method (Signature Program)](https://www.intentionholistichealth.com/services/): The most comprehensive engagement — everything in Mineral Insight, expanded with broader functional testing, ongoing visits, and a low-tox home reset over several months. Personalized pricing.
- [B2B Partner Program (The Mineral Method)](https://www.intentionholistichealth.com/partners/): Co-branded HTMA mineral health partnership for Kentucky perinatal and women's wellness practices.

## Testing philosophy

HTMA is the prioritized starting point because it shows foundational mineral patterns conventional labs aren't designed to capture, and it's a more accessible cost than many functional panels. Other functional testing is added on a patient-by-patient basis when the situation calls for it.

- [Running on Empty Awareness Guide](https://www.intentionholistichealth.com/depletion-signals.html): Free guide covering 8 common depletion patterns and informed questions to bring to your provider.
- [Healthy Kitchen Staples Checklist](https://www.intentionholistichealth.com/kitchen-staples.html): Printable guide for stocking nourishing, low-tox kitchen essentials.
- [Supplement Decision Framework](https://www.intentionholistichealth.com/supplement-guide.html): Evidence-informed framework for evaluating whether a supplement is right for you.
- [Blog](https://www.intentionholistichealth.com/blog/): Articles on minerals, HTMA, hormone health, postpartum recovery, fertility nutrition, and functional wellness.

## Key facts

- Services available to Kentucky residents only.
- Practitioner: Alicia Harrison, MSN, APRN, FNP-C, BHPCC (Family Nurse Practitioner, board-certified; biofield holistic practitioner credentialed).
- Specializations: HTMA (Hair Tissue Mineral Analysis), functional lab review, hormone balance, pregnancy preparation, postpartum recovery, mineral health for women.
- Clinical model: Foundations-first — minerals, sleep, nervous system, nutrition before pharmaceutical or aggressive intervention.
- Bookings handled via Practice Better; supplements dispensed via Fullscript.
